description: Edvisor.ai Courses Platform, CSUEB Economics, against the ACR by WCAG Designs dated 10/07/2026. Each review holds the inputs the matrix reads and the determination matrix version 3 gave for them on 2026-10-23.

sources.requisition: CSUEB IT purchase review form, new acquisition, completed by Zach Oshri for Dr. Filippo Rebessi

reviews.name: Edvisor.ai, as submitted
reviews.note: The requisition and the ACR analysis as they stand.

users.source: Approximate number of users: 101-500. The upper bound is used; the coursework floor sets High either way.

scope.source: One course in one department. Not systemwide.

required_use.source: Dr. Rebessi is "adopting Edvisor as required course material".

criticality.source: Readings, quizzes, assignments and grading for the course.

publishes.source: Generates a coursepack for the enrolled class.

contract_length.source: One year. Students buy access each term.
